main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual 1-bar move on bars with forecast <= -2

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 distinct case days

supporting_check.name: unusual move of top third minus bottom third by abs(forecast)

decided_by: Confirming t >= 2 but the supporting check (top third minus bottom third above 0) failed.
reading: Up day taken as close above the prior close within the window (the detector's regime on a window's first bar), light volume as the recorded centred volume ratio below 0; horizon 1 bar so every bar is a grid point; normal drift is each coin's mean 1-bar return over all its windows; the t sums case deviations per UTC day (no small-sample correction); thirds are equal-size splits of the cases sorted by abs(forecast); fewer than 300 case days gives 'not observable'.
